label: pjm next 2 joint
market_story: COAL_BIT/COAL_PRB (2019-2022): the pre-exit coal fleet (Morgantown, Zimmer, Avon Lake, Dickerson, Waukegan, Cheswick) sat dark for months before retiring, as their own CEMS shows; the model now carries those measured outage windows, so it stops running idle plants. CC_REGULAR (2022-2025): eastern CCs (SWMAAC, Dominion) buy gas at their delivered EIA-923 price, which already includes the regional premium; the premium is no longer added a second time, so they clear where the real market dispatched them. NUCLEAR (2019): TMI-1 ran until its September 2019 retirement; it now does.
